blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — A peasant organization criticized President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. for downplaying widespread protests against the US-led Pax Silica initiative, saying his remarks were aimed at appeasing public anger despite growing opposition to the project. “Mr. Marcos is again in his deceptive mode. It’s not new to him. He is merely trying to appease public anger and calm the people’s protests because the deceitful projects have been exposed and have further ignited the people’s wrath,” Jansept Geronimo, national spokesperson of the Kilusan para sa Repormang Agraryo at Katarungang Panlipunan (Katarungan), said in a phone interview on Nov. 21.
